100% free: by taxi drivers for taxi drivers

This app was born from the passion and commitment of a taxi driver who is also a developer. There are no big companies or hidden interests here: just the desire to contribute something useful and honest to our community.

Your trust and support make it possible for us to keep growing together, improving the daily life of taxi driving from within, with independence and professionalism. This app is yours as much as mine: a tool made by and for taxi drivers.
Taxi driving is much more than a job: it is a way of life, a community, and a family. Let\'s keep moving forward, supporting each other and defending what is ours with the best tools.
Thank you for being part of this community.

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE ON PLATFORMS WITH COMMISSION

Platforms that work with the \"Taximeter\" option and then deliver the price with the commission already discounted may show differences between the amount displayed on the taximeter of the platform\'s app and the amount that appears on the final receipt. This is normal and is because the platform\'s commissions have already been subtracted from the final price you receive.
